drafts.title: Resumes
drafts.description: Paste a job description to generate a tailored resume from your knowledge base — nothing beyond what's already there is ever added.
drafts.intro: The AI matches this job description against your career knowledge base and drafts a resume from what it finds. You can then edit or ask for changes before approving it.
drafts.empty: No resumes yet — paste a job description above to generate one

deleteDialog.title: Delete resume
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes this tailored resume draft.

editor.title: Resume
editor.description: Tailored from your knowledge base — nothing beyond what's already written there is ever added.

askForChange.heading: Ask for a change
askForChange.body: Tell the AI how to adjust this resume — e.g. "emphasize my backend experience" or "use the project section instead of the internship". It only rearranges what's already in your knowledge base.
askForChange.refineDisabledTitle: Save your changes before refining — refining regenerates content from what's already saved

template.heading: Choose a template
template.body: Content is locked now that this resume is approved — only presentation changes from here.
template.loadError: Failed to load templates — try reloading the page

final.heading: Final resume ready
final.documentLoadError: Failed to check for a finalized PDF — try reloading the page

toast.approved: Resume approved — content is now locked
